title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.28069v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training coding agents typically updates the policy while keeping the harness fixed. During training, trajectories reveal flawed repair strategies and interaction problems that vary across tasks and change as the policy learns. We introduce HarnessAdapt-RL, which trains the policy and adapts its harness during reinforcement learning. For flawed repair strategies, a frozen teacher generates task-specific mechanism-level skills. For interaction problems recurring across tasks, a separate teacher model evolves tools and hooks, keeping each change only if it improves the observed pass rate or the observed trainable rate without lowering either. The policy trains with the adapted harness, and its new trajectories guide further adaptation. translated_title: 训练完整的智能体，而不仅仅是模型
translated_abstract: 训练编码智能体通常只更新策略，而将外部框架固定不变。在训练过程中，轨迹会暴露出有缺陷的修复策略和交互问题，这些问题因任务而异，并随着策略的学习而不断变化。我们提出了 HarnessAdapt-RL，它在强化学习过程中同时训练策略并自适应调整其外部框架。针对有缺陷的修复策略，由一个冻结的教师模型生成任务特定的机制级技能；针对在多个任务中反复出现的交互问题，由另一个独立的教师模型演化工具和钩子，只有当某项更改能提高观测到的通过率或可训练率、且不降低任何一方时才予以保留。策略在调整后的外部框架下进行训练，其新生成的轨迹又会进一步指导框架的调整。基于 9B 基础模型，HarnessAdapt-RL 在 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 和 Pro 上分别将 pass@1 比 GRPO 提升了 9.8、12.6 和 6.4 个百分点，并优于使用人工设计的 OpenHands 框架的 GRPO。
tldr: HarnessAdapt-RL 首次提出在强化学习中同时训练策略并自适应调整其外部框架，利用教师模型生成机制级技能并演化工具与钩子，使 9B 模型在 SWE-bench 基准上比 GRPO 最高提升 12.6 个百分点的 pass@1。
en_tdlr: HarnessAdapt-RL is the first to jointly train the policy and adapt its harness during reinforcement learning—using teacher models to generate mechanism-level skills and evolve tools and hooks—boosting a 9B model's pass@1 by up to 12.6 percentage points over GRPO on SWE-bench benchmarks.
